_hint: Tracked template: every value is empty or a default. Copy to testsettings.local.json (gitignored) and fill it in, or supply the same keys as environment variables (Target__ApplicationUrl and so on). Keys starting with an underscore are notes and are ignored. The rules - a section is all-or-nothing, an empty or whitespace value counts as absent, the base URL must be absolute - are stated and enforced in FIPSAutomation/Configuration/ConfigurationSections.cs; each section's hint names the options class that owns its keys.

Target._hint: FIPSAutomation/Configuration/TargetOptions.cs. MANDATORY: the suite refuses to start without an absolute ApplicationUrl (a trailing slash is added if missing).

SignIn._hint: FIPSAutomation/Configuration/SignInOptions.cs. OPTIONAL, all-or-nothing: leave every value empty and the suite opens the application directly; supply any and all four are required. Plain values, not encoded.

Timeouts._hint: FIPSAutomation/Configuration/TimeoutOptions.cs. OPTIONAL: these are Playwright's defaults. Lower them for an application on this machine, where every failing test otherwise waits the full time.
